Subject: EMEA Q4 forecast — quick hygiene sweep

Team —

Quick reminder as we head into week 46: finance asked for final commit numbers and stage rationales for any deals currently in Proposal/Contract by next Friday (11/13). I pulled a draft export and flagged deals where stage has not moved in 30+ days. Please do the following before EOD Monday: 

- Confirm commit / commit probability for any deal you own in Proposal/Contract. If "commit" is >50%, set to Commit and sync ARR.
- For stalled deals, add one short reason in the HubSpot "stage notes" field (e.g., legal review, PO delay, pricing hold).
- Upload any new redline/PO to the shared forecast folder and mark in the spreadsheet.

I've attached a working worksheet (EMEA_Q4_forecast_v3.xlsx) with a separate tab for stuck deals. Finance will use the updated sheet for the regional rollup.

If you expect a change to the committed number >25% compared to last week, tag Neha and copy me so we can flag to FP&A.

Thanks — small, concrete asks.

—Vanessa
